import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json, time, os
TFS = ['FOXA1','GATA3','MAX','STAT1','OCT4','P53','NANOG','HNF4A','TBP','FOS','MYC','JUN','FOXO1','CTCF','TCF7','SOX2','E2F1','CREB1','GATA1','KLF3']
# P53 may be TP53, OCT4 POU5F1, TCF7 maybe TCF7/TCF7L2; search exact first.
base='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/'
items=[]
for tf in TFS:
    url='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'search':tf,'tax_group':'vertebrates','collection':'CORE','version':'latest'})
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        data=json.load(r)
    results=data.get('results',[])
    exact=[r for r in results if r.get('name','').upper()==tf.upper()]
    if not exact and tf=='P53':
        # try TP53
        url='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'search':'TP53','tax_group':'vertebrates','collection':'CORE','version':'latest'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}), timeout=60) as r2:
            data2=json.load(r2)
        exact=[r for r in data2.get('results',[]) if r.get('name','').upper() in ['TP53','P53']]
    if not exact and tf=='OCT4':
        for syn in ['POU5F1']:
            url='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'search':syn,'tax_group':'vertebrates','collection':'CORE','version':'latest'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}), timeout=60) as r3:
                data3=json.load(r3)
            exact=[r for r in data3.get('results',[]) if r.get('name','').upper()=='POU5F1']
            if exact: break
    if not exact and tf=='TCF7':
        for syn in ['TCF7','TCF7L2']:
            url='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'search':syn,'tax_group':'vertebrates','collection':'CORE','version':'latest'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}), timeout=60) as r4:
                data4=json.load(r4)
            exact=[r for r in data4.get('results',[]) if r.get('name','').upper() in ['TCF7','TCF7L2']]
            if exact: break
    if not exact:
        exact=results  # fallback all search results for that token, print later
    print(tf, [(r.get('matrix_id'),r.get('name'),r.get('version')) for r in exact])
    for r in exact:
        mid=r['matrix_id']
        murl=base+mid+'/'
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(murl, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}), timeout=60) as mr:
            m=json.load(mr)
        items.append(m)
        time.sleep(0.05)
print('TOTAL', len(items))
with open('inputs/jaspar_20_tfs_raw.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(items,f)
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
items=json.load(open('inputs/jaspar_20_tfs_raw.json'))
lines=[]
lines.append('MEME version 5')
lines.append('')
lines.append('ALPHABET= ACGT')
lines.append('')
lines.append('strands: + -')
lines.append('')
lines.append('Background letter frequencies')
lines.append('A 0.25 C 0.25 G 0.25 T 0.25')
lines.append('')
for m in items:
    pfm=m['pfm']
    letters=['A','C','G','T']
    width=len(pfm['A'])
    for l in letters:
        assert len(pfm[l])==width
    lines.append(f\"MOTIF {m['matrix_id']} {m['name']}_{m['matrix_id']}\")
    lines.append(f\"letter-probability matrix: alength= 4 w= {width} nsites= 20 E= 0\")
    for i in range(width):
        counts=[pfm[l][i] for l in letters]
        total=sum(counts)
        probs=[c/total for c in counts]
        lines.append('\\t'.join(f'{p:.6f}' for p in probs))
    lines.append('')
open('inputs/jaspar_20_tfs.meme','w').write('\\n'.join(lines))
print('wrote', len(items), 'motifs')
PY"
